title: SettlementEvent
description: One supervision-feed record per settled deal, mirroring the on-chain Settled event. seller_credit and buyer_credit are per role address and total: any challenger-bond routing is already inside the winning party's figure, and the challenger's identity comes from the Challenged event. Every settlement is reconstructable from events only; no contract state reads are needed.

reason.description: The Settled.reason recorded by the escrow for this settlement path.

seller_credit.description: Integer token base units credited to the seller's address on this settlement, including any returned seller bond and any challenger-bond routing.

buyer_credit.description: Integer token base units credited to the buyer's address on this settlement, including any slashed seller bond and any challenger-bond routing.

challenger_address.description: Present when the path was challenged; the address that posted the challenger bond, read from the Challenged event.

bond_slashed.description: Integer token base units of seller bond slashed to the buyer. Present only on ruling_refund, the single path on which the seller bond ever slashes.
